description.value: The Abbotsford Sports Hall of Fame honours local athletes, coaches, and builders who have achieved national and international recognition in their sports, and is housed on the first floor of the Legacy Sports Centre at Abbotsford Exhibition Park. Founded following the 1995 Western Canada Summer Games, it features inducted plaques and a yearly Wall of Fame recognizing junior athletes. A secondary display of inductee plaques is also located at Abbotsford Centre, making it a small but meaningful stop for cyclists interested in local sporting heritage.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active (2026 copyright, annual banquet scheduled) and located at 3270 Trethewey St., Abbotsford, B.C. within the Legacy Sports Centre at Abbotsford Exhibition Park. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields must be null. OSM lists Tuesday hours but the website's location page mentions only Saturday and Sunday operations, creating a discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Chilliwack' but the business is in Abbotsford — possible mis-assignment.
OSM opening_hours includes Tuesday but website location page states only Saturday and Sunday operations — discrepancy should be verified.
No phone number available in OSM or on website; contact is via Gmail address only.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hall of fame is a legitimate local attraction within a sports complex, but no cycling amenities are confirmed and the listing lacks a phone number and full postal address. A site visit or direct contact would be needed to verify whether the host facility (Legacy Sports Centre) provides bike parking or washrooms accessible to visitors.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email contact from website: abbotsfordsportshalloffame@gmail.com. The hall is volunteer-run and administered by the Kiwanis Club of Abbotsford.
